summary_md: **cv usk ([@cv_usk](https://x.com/cv_usk/status/2116096232297013666))** explains *MoRE: Mixture of Reused Experts* ([arXiv 2609.18176](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2609.18176)), where adjacent layers share one expert pool so that with N=32 and K=4 the number of expert combinations rises about 18× at equal parameter count, using only weight sharing and per-layer depth embeddings.
relevance: MoE architecture trick that could make local MoE models more capable per parameter.
